prefsSaved: Default provider and profile models saved.
step0Intro: Choose single-user, multi-user, or multi-organization for this installation.
modeSingleDesc: Just you — no user admin, tenant selection or organizations.
modeAgentDesc: Admin plus multiple users — no organizations.
modeTenantDesc: Organizations, tenant admins, knowledge companion per firm.
step1Intro: Create the administrator account for this instance.
setupTokenEnv: Value from AGENT_SETUP_TOKEN in server config (.env).
setupTokenLog: One-time in server log after start (e.g. docker compose logs agent-layer).
passwordHint: At least 12 characters: lower + upper + digit + symbol. No simple runs like 1234 or aaaa.
passwordRuleSequence: Avoid simple sequences or repeats (e.g. 1234, aaaa).
step2Intro: Configure chat endpoints, RAG, voice, and coding runtime.
aiPhase_endpoints_intro: Add at least one reachable OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Same form everywhere: import env, Name, Preset, URL, Key, Test, default model; Edit / Make primary on cards.
endpointEditHint: Editing this endpoint. Re-test connection if you change URL or key; then save.
cardUnreachableHint: Endpoint did not return models. Check URL, API key, network, or that the service is up. Env import kept the config as a draft — fix and retry, or delete.
cardNoModelHint: Endpoint is reachable but no default model is set. Edit, test, pick a model, then save.
endpointHealthFooter: One or more endpoints are not ready. You can skip optional steps, but RAG/voice will not work until status is Reachable with a default model.
envAutoImportedWithIssues: Imported {{count}} from environment. {{bad}} still not ready (see status on cards).
codingUsesChatModel: Internal coding turns use your chat default model ({{model}}). Change the model on the chat endpoint, or enable an external harness below.
codingUsesChatModelFallback: Internal coding turns use the chat endpoint default model from step 1. Enable a harness below to install and switch runtimes.
aiPhase_rag_intro: Optional. Same as chat: import from environment, or add an embedding endpoint (Name, Preset, URL, Key, Test, default model). Edit / Make primary on the cards.
aiPhase_voice_intro: Optional. Same endpoint form as chat for STT and TTS (import, Name, Preset, URL, Key, Test, model). The primary card for each kind becomes the active voice provider.
aiPhase_coding_intro: Optional. Use AgentLayer’s internal coding agent, and/or install external harnesses (Qwen Code, DeepSeek Harness) to switch between them.
noProvidersYet: No providers in the database yet. Add an endpoint below.
needReachableChat: Continue requires at least one reachable chat endpoint with models.
envAutoImported: Imported {{count}} from environment and probed models.
chatEmbedHint: Reuse a reachable chat provider URL for /v1/embeddings (saved in DB, no .env restart). Suggested model: {{model}}
chatEmbedBtn: Use chat provider for embeddings (RAG) too
showManualAdd: Add cloud or extra endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, …)
llmTestBeforeSave: Test the connection first so models can be listed.
llmPickModelFromList: Choose a model from the list returned by the endpoint.
voiceHint: Primary STT/TTS cards above are used as the active voice providers. Fine-tune later under Admin.
runtimeInternalDesc: Use AgentLayer’s own coding agent with your chat models.
runtimeMultiselectHint: Select one or more external harnesses. Missing packages are installed into the runtime volume on Finish (npm).
runtimeQwenDesc: External Qwen Code CLI (@qwen-code/qwen-code). Coding turns run outside AgentLayer’s planner.
runtimeDshDesc: External DeepSeek Harness headless CLI (@deepseek-ai/dsh). Coding turns run as dsh --profile headless.
runtimeApiMissing: Coding-runtimes API not found — rebuild/restart the backend image so /v1/admin/coding-runtimes is available.
runtimeSaveFailed: Could not save coding runtime settings.
step3Intro: The instance is ready. Pick the model in the chat composer; adjust profiles and endpoints under Admin → Interfaces.
llmTestNoModels: Connection OK but no models reported. Check the endpoint or pick a model from the list.
llmPresetProvider1Help: OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. Set LLM_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL in .env or enter the URL below.
embedPresetProvider1Help: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint. Set EMBEDDING_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL in .env or enter the URL below.
voiceSttPresetProvider1Help: OpenAI-compatible STT endpoint. Set VOICE_STT_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL in .env or enter the URL below.
voiceTtsPresetProvider1Help: OpenAI-compatible TTS endpoint. Set VOICE_TTS_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL in .env or enter the URL below.
llmPresetLlamaCppApiKeyHint: Only if your gateway requires an API key.
llmPresetLlamaCppHelp: Your llama.cpp or gateway endpoint with /v1/chat/completions.
llmPresetOpenaiHelp: Official OpenAI API. Model IDs like gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini.
llmPresetOpenrouterApiKeyHint: API key from openrouter.ai — one endpoint for many providers.
llmPresetOpenrouterHelp: Claude without native Anthropic adapter: pick model ID anthropic/claude-…. List at openrouter.ai/models.
llmPresetTogetherHelp: Many open-source and hosted models via an OpenAI-compatible API.
llmPresetCustomApiKeyHint: Bearer token if the provider requires auth.
llmPresetCustomHelp: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LiteLLM, your own proxy, …).
